# Ted Carter Inspired Landscapes

## About
Ted Carter Inspired Landscapes offers landscape design and construction for discerning clients desiring a bespoke landscape for their property. The company specializes in working with natural stone and transforming outdoor spaces across southern Maine and coastal New Hampshire. Ted Carter Inspired Landscapes is a design-build company, meaning consultation, design, installation, and project management are all handled by one team.

## Services
Landscape Consultation
Landscape Design
Landscape Installation
Project Management
